properties.decision:
RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL. Nothing here is intent, and no option is preferred.

WHERE IT CAME FROM: art:dev-reflow2-two-agent-exercise-feedback-2026-09-29, item D11. The designer measured today's reflow2 (cold open 1.25 s, about 54 MB, about 520 bytes per fact) as evidence for a NEW engine's budgets: cold reload ≤ 2,000 ms, memory ≤ 256 MiB per large design. It found three wrong homes:
- `basis: measured` on CONSTRAINS would claim it is the new part's own spend;
- a `passing` Verification on the budget would claim the new engine meets it;
- VERIFIES refuses a Decision.
The root cause (fact:root-cause-describe-schema-never-names-the-typed-tool-that-writes-a-type-and-the-map-lives-in-a-repo-script-2026-09-29) overturned half of the report: record_finding already WRITES such a record (value, basis measured, source, date) on a Constraint or Decision. What holds is that nothing READS it. budget_report ignores it, and no view puts it beside the limit.

SEARCHED ACCEPTED INTENT FIRST: req:a-quantity-carries-how-it-was-obtained-and-an-unsourced-one-is-reported (accepted) and cap:a-quantity-carries-its-provenance-and-an-unsourced-one-is-named (realized) cover HOW a quantity was obtained, but not a quantity measured on a DIFFERENT system that bounds this one. wish #39 (dec:idea-a-measurement-that-refutes-the-designs-own-rule-has-nowhere-to-point) is the nearest open idea: a measurement that bears on intent without being a verdict on it.

═══ OPTIONS ═══

(a) READ WHAT ALREADY EXISTS. Findings with basis `measured` and a value on a Constraint are listed by budget_report as "reference evidence", separate from contributors and never totalled. Findings on a Decision are listed wherever the decision is read back.
⚠️ Counter: `value` is free JSON with no unit field, so nothing can compare it with the limit, only show it.

(b) TYPED FIELDS ON THE OBSERVATION: quantity, unit and value; WHICH system was measured (this design, or a reference); and the relation it claims (e.g. "the new engine must be at least 2.1× faster than this").
⚠️ Counter: TemporalFact is already the type whose schema reply is too large to serve (47k chars on 0.74.0). Growing it makes the discoverability half of the root cause worse.

(c) A NEW EDGE from an observation to the node it bears on, with a bearing (supports, refutes, bounds).
⚠️ Counter: it moves the schema stamp, and wish #39 asked for a different new edge (REFINES) for a near-identical need. Two new edges for one family of needs is the wrong outcome, so if this road is taken, it should be taken once for both.

(d) LET VERIFIES ADMIT DECISION, the schema question left open by fact:root-cause-a-check-on-a-ruling-is-modelled-as-governed-by-and-the-verifies-refusal-never-says-so-2026-09-28.
⚠️ Counter: a Verification on a decision reads as "the decision is proven". A reference measurement only BOUNDS the decision's numbers, so this overclaims.

(e) INSTRUCTION ONLY: describe_schema names record_finding as TemporalFact's writer (the defect's fix), and people read findings by hand.
⚠️ Counter: it fixes finding the writer and leaves the reader missing. The owner agent in that exercise could not see the design at all, so "read by hand" reached nobody.
properties.name: OPEN — how does a dated measurement of a REFERENCE system (a predecessor, a competitor, a prototype) become evidence that a budget or decision reads, beside its limit, without being mistaken for the design's own measured spend or for a passing verdict?
